body: Original logo-free 2994 game vehicle art, transparent PNG, 7:4 landscape sheet, exactly eight whole separated views in a regular4x2 grid with generous gutters and margins. Inspired by stock1992 US Subaru SVX 3.3 AWD grand touring coupe, NO optional sunroof. Long low aerodynamic two-door coupe, distinctive glass-to-glass black canopy with small inset opening windows within large curved side windows, smooth wedge nose with slim fixed headlights, black roof, full-width slim rear lamp panel, stock modest integral tail spoiler. Weathered pearl ivory body with copper repair patches on both front fenders and charcoal lower cladding. Absolutely no logos, text, badges or lettering. ALL wheels and tires absent; transparent wheel holes for runtime wheels; no ground or shadows. Exact orientations: TOP ROW straight FRONT; FRONT LEFT quarter nose points RIGHT; full LEFT profile nose RIGHT; REAR LEFT quarter nose RIGHT. BOTTOM ROW straight REAR; REAR RIGHT quarter nose LEFT; full RIGHT profile nose LEFT; FRONT RIGHT quarter nose LEFT. Do not repeat left-facing views on the right side. Consistent car in all8cells, whole bumpers visible. Detailed painterly photoreal game art.
dashboard: Original logo-free 2994 vehicle-specific cockpit overlay, transparent background PNG, ultrawide3:1. Inspired by LEFT-hand-drive1992 Subaru SVX standard US grand touring coupe. View from driver's eyes across entire dashboard, black broad curved wraparound instrument binnacle occupying left third, EMPTY black instrument recess to receive live gauges; sculpted early1990s dark charcoal dashboard with soft gray suede midband sweeping into door panels, compact central rectangular vents above concealed stereo panel and automatic climate-control rectangle, smoothly integrated passenger dash. Distinctive thin A-pillars and low wide windshield, windshield area fully TRANSPARENT. No steering wheel: leave dark empty wheel zone in front of driver for runtime moving wheel. No printed instruments, needles, numbers, text, logos or badges. Subtle copper repair seams and distressed suede, restrained original year2994 salvage aesthetics. Main dash lower half, no hood, horizon, seats or exterior car. Keep controls clear and useful.
bodyCorrection: Edit this existing eight-view sprite sheet, retain exact grid, orientations, consistent ivory and charcoal1992 Subaru SVX-inspired two-door body, absent wheels, transparent background and original2994 salvage art. Remove the raised rear wing/spoiler from EVERY angle: standard SVX has a smooth plain trunk lid, absolutely no spoiler blade or supports. Critical SVX-specific glass canopy: add clearly visible small inset rounded rectangular opening windows inside the large fixed curved side glass on BOTH sides in each side/quarter view. The small opening pane has a black thin surround running through lower half of the much larger side glazing; this is the famous SVX window-within-window. Continuous black canopy roof, thin pillars, no sunroof. Preserve all8 directions exactly, no logos or text. Fully transparent wheel holes and surroundings.
windowCorrection: Small precise correction to this eight-view sprite sheet. All its car geometry and view directions remain unchanged. The little inset window has been incorrectly placed in the rear quarter glass. REMOVE that small oval from the rear quarter window in each side and quarter view. Instead draw the SVX window-within-window in the FRONT DOOR GLASS above the door handle: a long low rounded rectangular movable lower pane, bounded along its top by a black horizontal divider running from near the exterior mirror to the front door's rear edge, spanning roughly two thirds of the FRONT DOOR WINDOW width. The large fixed curved upper front-door glass remains above it. This horizontal split in front-door glass is the signature SVX canopy design. Rear quarter glazing must remain one plain undivided pane. Keep8separateviews, all orientations, no spoiler, no wheels, no badges, no text, transparent background. Ivory paint and charcoal lower cladding with copper front fender patches preserved.
dashboardCorrection: Correct first image dashboard overlay to the vehicle-specific1992 Subaru SVX architecture shown in second reference, keeping it an original logo-free2994 salvage reinterpretation, not a photo copy. Preserve transparent windshield upper area and blank gauge recess left. The SVX has VERTICAL-SLATTED central vents in a tall angled center stack integrated with the driver binnacle, not two horizontal wide vents across passenger dash. Put vertical-slat center air outlets, below them slim horizontal automatic climate buttons, and beneath these a hinged cover for stereo. Light gray suede band across passenger side; charcoal sculpted wraparound dash. Remove any steering wheel, original printed gauges, numerals, text, badges and logos. Leave dark empty driver cluster and wheel zone for live runtime gauges and moving wheel. Full wide dashboard with thin pillars and transparent windshield, ultrawide3:1. Preserve original subtle wear and copper repair stitching.
